## This markdown takes the pre-processed and labeled rna and atac objects, integrates them and performs differential analysis.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggrepel)
library(Signac)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(future)
library(AnnotationHub)
library(BSgenome.Ggallus.UCSC.galGal6)
library(dplyr)
library(GenomeInfoDb)
```

## Load rna and atac

```{r}
rna <- readRDS("rna_prePlot.rds")
atac <- readRDS("atac_prePlot.rds")
```

## Transfer Anchors and Imputation

```{r transfer-anchors}
transfer.anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
  reference = rna, 
  query = atac, 
  features = VariableFeatures(object = rna),
  reference.assay = "RNA", 
  query.assay = "ACTIVITY", 
  reduction = "cca"
)

genes.use <- VariableFeatures(rna)
rna <- JoinLayers(rna)
refdata <- GetAssayData(rna, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")[genes.use, ]

imputation <- TransferData(
  anchorset = transfer.anchors, 
  refdata = refdata, 
  weight.reduction = atac[["lsi"]],
  dims = 2:30
)
atac[["RNA"]] <- imputation
```

## Merge and Run UMAP

```{r merge-umap}
combined <- merge(x = rna, y = atac)
combined <- ScaleData(combined, features = genes.use, do.scale = FALSE)
combined <- RunPCA(combined, features = genes.use, verbose = FALSE)
combined <- RunUMAP(combined, dims = 1:30)

saveRDS(combined, "combined.rds")
```

## Differential Accessibility (ATAC)

```{r subset-atac}
atac_MG <- subset(atac, predicted.id %in% c("resting MG", "activated MG"))
Idents(atac_MG) <- atac_MG$predicted.id
DefaultAssay(atac_MG) <- 'ATAC'

#This takes a very long time, already saved for easy use
 da_peaks <- FindMarkers(
   object = atac_MG,
   ident.1 = "activated MG",
   ident.2 = "resting MG",
   test.use = "LR",
)

write.csv(da_peaks, file = "da_peaks.csv", row.names = TRUE)
da_peaks <- read.csv("da_peaks.csv")
head(da_peaks)
```

## Volcano Plot: Differential Accessible Peaks

```{r volcano-peaks}
da_peaks$log_pval <- -log10(da_peaks$p_val + 1e-10)
da_peaks$Significant <- ifelse(da_peaks$p_val < 0.05 & abs(da_peaks$avg_log2FC) > 0.25, "Yes", "No")

volcano_plot <- ggplot(da_peaks, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = log_pval, color = Significant)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot: Differential Accessible Peaks",
       x = "Average Log2 Fold Change",
       y = "-Log10 p-value") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("No" = "grey", "Yes" = "red"))

print(volcano_plot)
```

## Differential Activity on Combined Object between activated MG cluster and resting MG cluster

```{r diff-activity}
Idents(combined) <- combined$celltype
DefaultAssay(combined) <- 'ACTIVITY'
da_activity <- FindMarkers(
  object = combined,
  ident.1 = "activated MG",
  ident.2 = "resting MG",
  test.use = "LR",
)
head(da_activity)
write.csv(da_activity, file = "da_activity.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```

## Volcano Plot: Differential Activity between MG clusters, print top 10 up and down regulated genes by log2FC

```{r volcano-activity}
da_activity$log_pval <- -log10(da_activity$p_val + 1e-10)
#remove inisgnificant
da_activity$Significant <- ifelse(da_activity$p_val < 0.05 & abs(da_activity$avg_log2FC) > 0.25, "Yes", "No")

top_up   <- head(rownames(da_activity[order(-da_activity$avg_log2FC), ]), 10)
top_down <- head(rownames(da_activity[order( da_activity$avg_log2FC), ]), 10)
top_genes <- c(top_up, top_down)

table(top_up)
table(top_down)

da_activity$label <- ifelse(rownames(da_activity) %in% top_genes, rownames(da_activity), NA)

volcano_plot <- ggplot(da_activity, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = log_pval)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Significant), alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot: Differential Activity (activated vs resting MG)",
       x     = "Average Log2 Fold Change",
       y     = "-Log10(p‑value)") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("No" = "grey", "Yes" = "red")) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), na.rm = TRUE, box.padding = 0.3, point.padding = 0.2, segment.size = 0.2)

print(volcano_plot)
```

## Adjusted p-value

```{r volcano-activity-adj}
da_activity$log_padj <- -log10(da_activity$p_val_adj + 1e-10)

#adjusted p‑value
da_activity$Significant <- ifelse(
  da_activity$p_val_adj < 0.05 & abs(da_activity$avg_log2FC) > 0.25,
  "Yes", "No"
)

#top 10 up‑ and down‑regulated genes by log2FC
top_up_adj   <- head(rownames(da_activity[order(-da_activity$avg_log2FC), ]), 10)
top_down_adj <- head(rownames(da_activity[order( da_activity$avg_log2FC), ]), 10)
top_genes_adj <- c(top_up, top_down)

# 4. Create a label column for those 20 genes
da_activity$label <- ifelse(
  rownames(da_activity) %in% top_genes,
  rownames(da_activity),
  NA
)

volcano_plot_adj <- ggplot(da_activity, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = log_padj)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Significant), alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot: Differential Activity (activated vs resting MG)",
    x     = "Average Log2 Fold Change",
    y     = "-Log10(adjusted p‑value)"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("No" = "grey", "Yes" = "red")) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = label),
    na.rm        = TRUE,
    box.padding   = 0.3,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    segment.size  = 0.2
  )

# 6. Display
print(volcano_plot_adj)

table(top_up_adj)

```


# 12 Top/Bottom 10 Genes Using Both Activity and Rna
```{r dual-differential}
## Combined Differential Expression (RNA) & Activity (ATAC)

combined <- readRDS("combined.rds")

# 1. Ensure identities and assays are set
Idents(combined) <- combined$celltype


# 2. RNA differential expression (Wilcoxon)
DefaultAssay(combined) <- "RNA"
combined <- JoinLayers(combined)

da_rna <- FindMarkers(
  object   = combined,
  ident.1  = "activated MG",
  ident.2  = "resting MG",
  test.use = "wilcox"
)

library(tibble)
library(dplyr)

write.csv(da_rna %>% rownames_to_column("gene"), 
          file = "da_rna_full.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 4. Merge RNA & ATAC results by gene

da_rna   <- da_rna   %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
da_activity <- da_activity %>% rownames_to_column("gene")

da_combined <- inner_join(
  da_rna, da_activity,
  by        = "gene",
  suffix    = c(".rna", ".activity")
) %>%
  # 5. Compute a simple combined score: mean absolute log2FC
  mutate(
    combined_score = (abs(avg_log2FC.rna) + abs(avg_log2FC.activity)) / 2
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(combined_score))

# 6. Pick top 20 genes by combined_score
top_combined <- da_combined %>% slice_head(n = 200)

# 7. Save to CSV
write.csv(
  top_combined,
  file      = "da_combined_20_genes.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(da_combined, file = "da_combined_full.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 8. (Optional) preview
head(top_combined)

```
